answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused price movement, so renewal or further term negotiation is unlikely to achieve the mandated 18% component-spend reduction. Prior evidence indicates the low-cost vendor delivered sharp unit-cost savings and quick onboarding, but the archived record should be verified because it does not establish delivery performance under the current 94%-utilization, no-buffer condition. Proceed only as a controlled primary-switch implementation with explicit delivery, capacity, quality, and continuity gates; incumbent stability remains valuable context but does not resolve the cost mandate.
